assets.name: research-value-trials-v1
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a refined handcrafted paper-sculpture editorial illustration for a clinical research website, landscape 3:2. Tactile cut cream paper, folded dark teal cardstock, sage green and small ochre accents, soft realistic studio shadows, warm near-white seamless background. Quiet, human, precise, consistent with a premium miniature paper diorama. Simple bold composition readable in a small three-column card. No text, letters, numbers, titles, watermarks, or charts claiming performance. Subject: screening clinical trial participants. A researcher's hand carefully selecting one cream patient record card from a small fan of several patient cards in a dark teal file tray; each card has a small sculpted person silhouette and evidence strips, the selected card has a single ochre tab. Focus on thoughtful selection supported by records. No checkmarks implying clinical approval.

assets.name: research-value-registry-v1
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a refined handcrafted paper-sculpture editorial illustration for a clinical research website, landscape 3:2. Tactile cut cream paper, folded dark teal cardstock, sage green and small ochre accents, soft realistic studio shadows, warm near-white seamless background. Quiet, human, precise, consistent with a premium miniature paper diorama. Simple bold composition readable in a small three-column card. assets.name: research-value-risk-v1
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a refined handcrafted paper-sculpture editorial illustration for a clinical research website, landscape 3:2. Tactile cut cream paper, folded dark teal cardstock, sage green and small ochre accents, soft realistic studio shadows, warm near-white seamless background.
